scope.purpose: Evaluate whether shortlisted source samples map to NT-compatible catalog classes and the ParquetDataCatalog input path.

current_bte_manifest_exposure.reason: run_manifest.rs maps TradeTick and OrderBookDelta into NautilusDataType, supports configured instrument_ids and multiple [[catalog_inputs]], and rejects unmapped data_type strings. Fidelity matching accepts TradeTick for TRADE_REPLAY and requires OrderBookDelta for L2_REPLAY while allowing supplemental TradeTick.

source_sample_mapping_status.decision: NT catalog/backtest input path is proven for this date-specific accepted Bybit source proof by the accepted 2026-04-16 canonical conversion, NT TradeTick catalog projection, query_typed_data read-back, BacktestNode iteration evidence, publication, and direct S3 catalog read-back.

task_conclusion.reason: BTE-022 is proven for this date-specific Bybit TradeTick path; broad mapping remains open for other source families and data classes.

non_hardcoding_rules_for_the_next_mappin: Add NT data-class support by table family and source schema contract, not by venue name.
Keep concrete source bindings in TOML/proof artifacts and keep runtime mapping selected through source proof, not code constants.
Reuse NT instrument providers/parsers where NT already owns a venue instrument model.
Only build Bolt-owned adapters for raw-source-to-NT-typed data projection when NT does not already provide that raw-source parser.
Each new data class must have ParquetDataCatalog write and query_typed_data read-back proof before BacktestNode input is accepted.
